notes: The narrated cut (composition Narrated, src/narrated/plan.ts) reuses part A's 1-4 and part B's 6, 7 and 8a from .claude/skills/recordly-demo/examples/discount-used-cars/storyboard.json; these are the shots captured for it.

Desk on :5190 only, next dev with DESK_PREVIEW_MEMBER=fresh, DESK_ALLOW_UNSET_FACTS=true and NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 (the address step's Census lookup goes out through the proxy; without it the city, ZIP and county never fill). Clock 2026-10-02 14:00 CDT.

Order on ONE fresh server: onboard Maria Lopez (7-desk-onboard into scratch, or capture/onboard step), 20-car, 21-buyer (its Start Sale makes the deal; note the deal path, e.g. /admin/sales/preview-deals-3), the licence review confirmed off camera (Check What The Card Says, to the funding step), 22-money and 23-plan with --var deal=<id>, the rest of the guide answered off camera from capture/carter-balance.json, 24-desk-qr, then the packet's signing link (Open here) into 26-phone-sign's url and a second session's link into 26b-phone-sign, then Mark Sold And Close off camera, then 27-desk-stored.

The documents (public/docs/narr-bos-p2.png, narr-130u-p1.png, narr-bos-p4-signed.png) are pdftoppm -r 300 renders of that deal's own PDFs (the bill of sale and the 130-U before signing, the bill of sale's page 4 after).

21-buyer's licence scan uses a test camera feed: getUserMedia returns a canvas stream of a card marked DEMO CARD with a PDF417 (AAMVA) barcode made for James Carter; the desk decodes it for real. 20-car's language menu is a stand-in drawn where the OS select popup opens (headless Chromium does not paint native popups); the value is set on the real select.
The second phone session (26b) cannot reuse the first session's stroke and refuses a pixel-identical one: its drawing is the same hand, scaled 0.95 and shifted (+9,+4).
